name: Midorikawa Chihiro
source:
Personality: Cool x Oresama (normal), Passionate x Obedient (Tlicolity)
Profession: Actor
Hobby: Training
Favorite food: Chicken, Youkan (Bean Jelly)
Disliked food: Cake with too much whipped cream, Oily food

A young popular actor who is gathering a lot of attention lately, he belongs to the same 'Iris' agency as Sakura.
He has a cool and calm personality but also a bit of an oppressive 'ore-sama' side.
He's quite strict towards his acting partner Sakura, who is an amateur just jumping into the acting world.
